units.source_text: 是谎言，毫无置疑是大谎言！

en.t: It is a lie, without a doubt a huge lie!

units.source_text: 你母亲只顾着在外面拼命工作，让大家觉得她是个了不起的人，实际上她心里最坏了。

en.t: Your mother only cares about working herself to death outside, making everyone think she is a remarkable person, but in truth she has the worst heart of all.

units.source_text: 奶奶被她欺负的团团转，她固执又好强……”

en.t: Grandmother is being bullied and pushed around by her; she is stubborn and headstrong...
